final: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / SUM(SUM(telescope_count)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM station_usage GROUP BY lunarstage
